title: Edge of Eternities | Kadrik and the Pod

entities.name: Kadrik
entities.description: A second-generation Eumidian vanguard and underperformer facing recycling, who deserts, finds a Kav stasis pod holding a human, and returns a hero before deciding to draw.

entities.name: Zoritt
entities.description: Kadrik's broodmate and only real friend, a med-lab scientist who tends the human.

entities.name: Pabkoh
entities.description: A first-generation vanguard who helps carry the pod and arranges a ship for Noz.

entities.name: Noz
entities.description: A human artist and worker in Pinnacle's programming division, held by the Kav and kept in stasis for three years, who is rescued by Kadrik.

entities.name: Gobbler
entities.description: A huge fanged, tusked and clawed megafauna awakened by Evendo's thaw, who steals Kadrik's pods and attacks the stasis pod.

entities.name: Evendo
entities.description: A formerly ice-bound world being terraformed into a Eumidian paradise, once lush with life and now thawing.

entities.name: Eumidians
entities.description: A people of insectoid terraformers on Evendo who share a union-mind and recycle the dead and damaged.

entities.name: Kav
entities.description: A people who ruined their own world by mining and tried and failed to take Evendo from the Eumidians.

entities.name: Pinnacle
entities.description: The galaxy's self-appointed administrators, whose programming division employs Noz.

entities.name: Guideline
entities.description: A Pinnacle station where Noz invites Kadrik to visit.

entities.name: Terrasymbiosis
entities.description: The process by which Eumidian seed pods make a planet habitable.

events.summary: Kadrik recounts gnawing off his left hind leg shortly after hatching and getting a fungal replacement foot.
events.quote: I got a little too excited and ended up gnawing off the end of my left hind leg

events.summary: Kadrik explains his mission to retrieve the last unhatched pods and that failing it means being reprocessed.
events.quote: My ongoing mission is to retrieve the last few unhatched pods scattered across the muddy plains.

events.summary: Gobbler repeatedly eats the pods Kadrik finds.
events.quote: She chases me away and—you won't believe this—gobbles up my find.

events.summary: Kadrik cuts off comms and deserts toward the tundra.
events.quote: I'm cutting off comms, spitting out my tracker, and deserting.

events.summary: On the fifth day Kadrik finds a Kav stasis pod camouflaged on the tundra.
events.quote: I nearly miss the stasis pod

events.summary: Kadrik sees that the pod holds a living human.
events.quote: Inside is not a Kav. It's a human.

events.summary: Kadrik decides to bring the human back to the enclave.
events.quote: I hitch the stasis pod to my sledge and turn back toward the enclave.

events.summary: Gobbler throws Kadrik's sledge and attacks the pod.
events.quote: I'm knocked out of my sledge as it flies backward and crashes on its side in an explosion of dirt.

events.summary: Kadrik flees and leaves the human to Gobbler.
events.quote: I scramble over, shove my sledge upright, and scramble on.

events.summary: Guilt-ridden, Kadrik turns back to rescue the human.
events.quote: With a snarl, I swing the sledge back around.

events.summary: Kadrik jams his staff and energy pack into Gobbler's jaws and the blast stuns her.
events.quote: I rip off my energy pack.

events.summary: The explosion destroys Kadrik's foot, which regrows from mycelial tissue.
events.quote: The whole world flashes green as pain engulfs my left hind leg.

events.summary: Kadrik reaches the enclave, where Zoritt hits him and tells him the recycling threat was a joke.
events.quote: What I don't expect, when we finally reach the enclave, is for Zoritt to knock me over the head with xir fist.

events.summary: Zoritt says it was a joke that they would recycle him.
events.quote: That was a joke, you idiot!

events.summary: Zoritt and the scientists move the human into a biocradle, and Kadrik takes the cylinder clutched in the human's hand.
events.quote: There's a cylindrical thing clenched in one hand, and I swipe it before Zoritt banishes me and Pabkoh outside.

events.summary: Kadrik eats the cylinder, thinking it a snack.
events.quote: I pop it in my mouth and crunch down.

events.summary: Kadrik meets the awakened human, who introduces himself as Noz.
events.quote: I-I'm Noz

events.summary: Kadrik exaggerates that he fought off five megafauna with bare hands.
events.quote: Had to fight off five megafauna with bare hands.

events.summary: Noz says he is from Pinnacle's programming division and was captured by the Kav.
events.quote: We were on a team-building exercise when the Kav took us captive.

events.summary: Noz tells them he was in stasis for three years.
events.quote: Three years, I know.

events.summary: Noz warns that the Kav are biding their time with a new warship.
events.quote: We were taken by a brand-new warship and held on a station retrofitted for battle.

events.summary: Noz insists on leaving to reach his family and report to Pinnacle.
events.quote: But I have a daughter.

events.summary: Noz asks for his pencil and learns Kadrik ate it.
events.quote: Oh, your snack. I ate it. Sorry.

events.summary: Noz encourages Kadrik to be the first Eumidian artist.
events.quote: Maybe you can be the first to change that.

events.summary: Noz thanks Kadrik and invites him to visit Guideline before leaving.
events.quote: Maybe you can even visit me on Guideline.

events.summary: After Noz leaves, Kadrik begins to draw a pair of tusks in the dirt with the stick.
events.quote: Then I crouch down, digging one end of the stick into the soft dirt, and begin to draw a pair of tusks.

relations.note: Zoritt is Kadrik's broodmate and only real friend.
relations.quote: I talk about Zoritt, my only real friend

relations.note: Kadrik is a vanguard of the Eumidians.
relations.quote: These are my people, my family.

relations.note: Noz works in Pinnacle's programming division.
relations.quote: I'm with the Pinnacle's programming division

relations.note: Gobbler stalks Kadrik and steals his finds.
The Kav tried to scare the Eumidians off Evendo.
relations.quote: tried (and failed!) to scare us off and take the planet for themselves.
